findings.title: Race Condition
findings.trigger: Concurrent access to the queue by multiple threads without proper synchronization
findings.assumptions: The `prot_queue` implementation does not handle concurrent access properly, leading to race conditions.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: If the data pushed into the queue is used later to construct and execute a command without proper sanitization
findings.assumptions: The data pushed into the queue might be used to construct and execute a command later in the program.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: Pushing more elements into the queue than its capacity
findings.assumptions: The `prot_queue` implementation does not enforce strict bounds checking, allowing buffer overflow.

findings.title: Improper Resource Management
findings.trigger: Potential resource leak if thread creation fails or joining fails
findings.assumptions: Proper error handling is not implemented for thread creation and joining.
